name: skillset
description: Topic-scoped Agent Skills + MCP servers. One topic per git branch.

plugins.name: coding
plugins.description: Language-agnostic software engineering: TDD, debugging, design, code review, commits. MCP: context7, sequential-thinking, GitHub.

plugins.name: code-typescript
plugins.description: TypeScript: strict typing, schema-validated I/O and modern tooling (Bun, Biome, Vitest, tsconfig).

plugins.name: code-python
plugins.description: Python: typed, modern Python with uv, Ruff, Pyright and pytest.

plugins.name: code-rust
plugins.description: Rust: idiomatic ownership, error handling, best practices (Apollo), async patterns with Tokio, Clippy-clean code, and porting other languages to Rust (rust-anything). MCP: rust-anything.

plugins.name: game-dev
plugins.description: Game development with Godot 4: GDScript conventions, game loop architecture. MCP: godot-mcp.

plugins.name: 3d-dev
plugins.description: 3D content pipelines: Blender Python scripting and glTF export/optimisation. MCP: blender-mcp.

plugins.name: web
plugins.description: Web development: frontend (React, accessibility, performance) and backend (HTTP API design, auth, data). MCP: Playwright.

plugins.name: k8s-infra
plugins.description: Kubernetes infrastructure: production-ready manifests, Helm/Kustomize, and cluster troubleshooting. MCP: kubernetes (read-only).

plugins.name: security
plugins.description: Offensive security for authorized testing: 83 bug-bounty / red-team skills (hunt-* web vuln classes, framework & enterprise attack chains, recon/OSINT, triage & reporting), vendored from Claude-BugHunter.

plugins.name: web-perf
plugins.description: Web performance: Core Web Vitals, loading/bundle/image optimisation (addyosmani) and compositor-friendly animation (ibelick).

plugins.name: ui-ux
plugins.description: UI/UX design: Web Interface Guidelines (Vercel), design-system intelligence (UI UX Pro Max) and WCAG 2.2 accessibility (addyosmani).

plugins.name: database
plugins.description: Databases: Postgres performance and best practices (Supabase): queries, indexes, pooling, locking, RLS, schema design.

plugins.name: seo
plugins.description: SEO: technical/on-page audits (coreyhaines), search best practices and structured data (addyosmani), site structure and internal linking (aaron-he-zhu).
